hallucinated_span_rate.definition: spans whose quoted words are NOWHERE in the document / all spans attempted (SS6.4 rule 2 read literally: the checker verifies substrings against the DOCUMENT). A quote that verifies but sits at a different index is SS6.6.1's `wrong-location`, a label error, and is counted separately.

index_agreement.gate: none — reported as a finding about the labeler
index_agreement.definition: fraction of verified spans whose claimed (unit, first, last) equalled the location its own quote resolves to. Misindexed spans were RELOCATED to the quote's position (D1-snapped to whole sentences in one unit), not discarded.

unresolvable_spans.definition: quote is in the document but its interval crosses a unit boundary or no unit contains it; span dropped

self_consistency.definition: Jaccard(char-span union of run 1, run 2) >= 0.5; two empty verdicts count as consistent

HUMAN_HALF: PENDING-HUMAN — kappa(human-human), kappa(Scout-human), positive-class agreement and the wrong-location / non-minimal / missed-evidence rates require the two-reader R-dev read (SS6.6.2). No agent read is a substitute and none was performed.
